name: han-domestic-task-ambiguity-benchmark-v1
description:
Domestic Task Ambiguity Benchmark
	

A benchmark dataset designed to analyze
how ambiguity in human instructions
affects task understanding in humanoid robots.

	
		
		Methods
	

Instructions are annotated based on
explicitness and reference clarity.

	
		
		Use Cases
	


Ambiguity handling research
Instruction disambiguation


	
		
		Limitations
	

No multi-step task chains included.

	
		
		Part of
	

Humanoid Network (HAN)

	
		
		License
	

MIT
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset for research on instruction ambiguity in domestic robotics with limited but growing use.
